GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS AND
  EFFICIENCY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 15, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:30 PM

Kristina Duggan, Chair
Dr. Joni Ricks-Oddie, Vice Chair
Mary Zendejas, Member

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-55003  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Government Operations and
  Efficiency Committee meeting of Tuesday, October 15, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-55019  Recommendation to receive Charter Commission appointments and
  reappointment’s pursuant to Section 509 of the City Charter and Section 2.03.065
  of the Long Beach Municipal Code, and forward this item to the City Council for
  approval.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  25-55005  Recommendation to approve the proposed Government Operations and Efficiency
  Committee Discussion Plan:
  • A discussion on City Council meeting processes for better community
  engagement;
  • Updates on staffing levels and implementation of Measure JB;
  • Consider Ethics Commission recommendations; and
  • A discussion on best practices for community meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
